scope: Read-only source review; only this new JSON was written. No compiler, engine, native match, Git mutation, large source copy, or hash matrix.

source_evidence.patch: Six-file diff: CMakeLists.txt, search.hpp, search.cpp, uci.cpp, README.md, IDEA_SOURCE.md.
source_evidence.off_source_erasure: The current four code/build files erase to baseline under the supplied checker; manual inspection finds only simple #ifdef guards without #else/#elif.
source_evidence.prefetch_sites: Two unchanged qsearch/main sites plus two conditional sites immediately after null-move and ProbCut make; TTEntry=16 and TTCluster=64 assertions retained.

reasoning.race_and_lifetime: Requested option and once-per-Searcher announcement state are atomic. Relaxed ordering suffices for independent booleans. Searcher snapshots once before helper construction; immutable worker_limits remains alive through helper joins, and each worker copies to its own member before recursion. The existing no-concurrent-clear/resize/destruction TT contract remains necessary.
reasoning.uci_and_bench: UCI setoption already stops and joins active search; only true/false are accepted. UCI bench copies requested state into its temporary Searcher. clear does not reset requested or announced state. Announcement is once per Searcher facade, including a distinct temporary facade per bench command.
reasoning.build_and_layout: CMake switch defaults OFF; PUBLIC definition consistently propagates guarded header layout to linked targets when ON. No changed TT entry/cluster definition, score, ordering constant, NNUE source, or network is present in the patch.
reasoning.provenance: Additions are simple Forge-local plumbing and calls to its existing prefetch method. IDEA_SOURCE records Forge and crew handoff provenance; no external engine code or tuned constants appear in the additions.

findings.detail: erase_feature drops an entire feature block including #else/#elif arms, rather than evaluating its OFF arm. A mutated null-child guard with an #else return 0 still returns PASS_SOURCE_ONLY, although that mutation changes build-OFF search behavior.
findings.reproduction: In-memory mutation only: insert #else plus return 0 before the new null-child guard endif; validate_source(candidate, baseline) returned PASS_SOURCE_ONLY.
findings.impact: No production issue found: actual candidate contains no such alternative feature arm. Checker could miss a future OFF-path regression.
findings.suggestion: Reject #else/#elif within these intentionally simple feature guards and add this mutation as a negative control, or implement true OFF-branch projection.

diagnostic_review.useful: Includes actual candidate search.cpp and intercepts TT builtin prefetch on GCC/Clang; fresh single-worker Searchers compare move, score, depth, seldepth, nodes and PV, count null attempts, derive excess ProbCut requests, require both paths, and check once-per-facade output.
limitations: Global non-atomic request counter and cout streambuf capture are valid only for the hardcoded one-worker diagnostic; do not reuse for SMP without synchronization.
Replaced hardware prefetch is request-count instrumentation, not production instruction, cache-effect, address-validity, sanitizer, speed, or strength evidence.

ProbCut coverage is derived from aggregate ON-minus-OFF requests less null attempts; it assumes identical internal traversal and unchanged existing request sites. Matching SearchInfo is helpful but is not a full trace equivalence proof.
Four fresh fixed-depth positions do not cover warm searches, option toggling, UCI protocol handling, concurrent setter snapshot behavior, stop/ponder lifecycle, or SMP.

Compile later with matching candidate headers and ON macro, supporting sources excluding a separately compiled search.cpp, and matching NNUE/floating-point settings. Non-GNU/non-Clang builds retain the existing no-op prefetch implementation.

Standalone forge_bench does not set the runtime option and remains OFF even in an ON-capable build; use setoption plus UCI bench or an explicit ON harness. UCI bench timing includes its first active-line output.

wording_note: The negative test named racy_recursive_requested_read actually rejects per-node atomic reads that violate snapshot semantics; those atomic reads alone would not constitute a C++ data race.
